successBar: Each item names the conversion or info-finding outcome it unlocks.
scope: Broad strategic audit (not narrow per-session). 9-axis sweep emphasizing redundance elimination, brand cohesion, AI/IGNIS depth, internal-tool integration, mobile/perf/SEO, and innovation that no SaaS studio currently does.

items.summary: Eliminate the 14-way vault/member namespace collision.
items.problem: Live sitemap contains six membership-family pages (/member/, /members/, /membership/, /membership-value/, /vault-member/, /vault-portal/) and eight vault-prefix pages (/vault-portal/, /vault-member/, /vault-treasury/, /vault-wall/, /vault-narrative/, /vaultsparked/, /vault/tombstones/, plus /vaultspark-football-gm/). Visitors and AI crawlers cannot model the IA. The chooser at /vault-portal/ already proves the founder accepts a single entrypoint.
items.recipe: Pick canonical set: /vault/ (chooser, formerly /vault-portal/) → /vault/member/ (formerly /vault-member/, /member/, /members/, /membership/, /membership-value/) and /vault/investor/ (existing). Move /vaultsparked/ → /vault/sparked/ or merge into /vault/member/wall. Worker Layer 0c carries 12+ edge 301s; tests/redirects.spec.js asserts every legacy path. Sitemap entries collapse from 14 → 5.
items.outcome: −9 pages from sitemap; AI crawler citations point at one canonical /vault/; mental model: one Vault, three doors (member, investor, sparked-wall).

items.summary: Move personalization from client hydration to Worker edge rewrite.
items.problem: S123 forbade personalization on `/` because client-side DOM mutation flashed + leaked enums. Today personalization (rank chip, name in nav, member tier hints) only lives in dropdowns and portal. Visitors who already paid for a tier see a generic homepage.
items.recipe: On any HTML response, Worker reads `vs_member` cookie → KV cache `member-snapshot:` (rank, name, points, next-tier-gap, unclaimed-count). HTMLRewriter replaces `guest`, `Vault Guest`, and a `data-vs-personal-cta` slot. Voice-leak guarded — enums never reach output; only humanized strings. Falls through to generic when cookie absent or KV miss.
items.outcome: Time-to-personalized-paint <50ms (vs ~400ms client hydration); logged-in member → /vault/ CTR target +30%; no flash; no enum leak.

items.summary: Collapse 9 intelligence surfaces into one Oracle spine with progressive disclosure.
items.problem: Studio Pulse / Forge Window, Ecosystem Oracle, Portfolio Heartbeat, Forge Forecast, Studio Milestones, Signal Log, Live Activity, Vault Genome Strip, Forge-Live ticker — nine surfaces with overlapping data and competing visual language. Visitors don't know where to look. /signal-log/ + /journal/ + /press/ + /changelog/ also overlap.
items.recipe: Canonical: /oracle/ = deep hub. Home spine = three tile teasers (Pulse · Forecast · Signal). Genome strip + rank-orb + favicon pulse = ambient layer. Sunset /signal-log/ → 301 to /journal/?tag=signal. Sunset /ignis-health/ → merge into /oracle/#health. /vault-narrative/ → /journal/?tag=narrative. /studio-pulse/ stays as the curated 'right-now' tab inside /oracle/.
items.outcome: Information architecture: 1 hop from home to any live-data answer; −4 pages from sitemap; brand consistency across intelligence surfaces.

items.summary: Extend dispatch-voice TTS to all long-form prose with a real founder-voice clone, R2-cached.
items.problem: S126 shipped Web Speech API TTS on `/journal/dispatches/`. Generic synth voice. Long-form prose lives on /universe/dreadspike/, project landing pages, /press/, /brand/, /journal/ — none currently narrated. Founder parasocial trust is leaked.
items.recipe: ElevenLabs (or open-source XTTS-v2 self-hosted on Hetzner) clone of founder voice. Build-time generate `data-narratable` paragraph audio → R2 → `<audio>` ref. Cap: only paragraphs marked `data-narratable` (founder-curated). Player UI: gold pulse next to heading, click → narrated, pause-on-scroll. Web Speech API fallback for un-cached.
items.outcome: Dwell time on /universe/dreadspike/ + project pages target +40%; founder-voice as brand surface (no studio currently ships this); accessibility (a11y) wins for partially-sighted visitors.

items.summary: IGNIS streams a narrative line every 5min into /api/ignis-conduit.json; hero ticker + favicon pulse react.
items.problem: Hero ticker today reads a static-ish recent-ships JSON. IGNIS already has voice synthesis + ecosystem-state aggregation; it isn't surfaced as a real-time narrator.
items.recipe: Studio-Ops cron (existing) writes one IGNIS-voice sentence per 5min into `ignis/output/conduit.ndjson` based on detected commit/session/milestone signals. Worker proxies tail-3 to /api/ignis-conduit.json. `assets/hero-ticker.js` rotates through them. Adds 'IGNIS is reading the studio' label.
items.outcome: Homepage feels alive every visit; return-visitor question 'what changed?' answered in 1 glance; ambient brand signal.

items.summary: /feedback/ shows 'You asked → We shipped' timeline.
items.problem: Micro-feedback widget captures input but visitors never see what happened to it. Submission rate is the floor of what it could be.
items.recipe: Build-time aggregator joins `vault_feedback` rows (tagged + acknowledged) to commit SHAs/SIL entries. Renders timeline cards: 'A member asked for X → shipped in S{N} → link to commit + before/after.' Anonymized. New /feedback/ page; cross-link from the micro-feedback widget submit success state ('See where this goes →').
items.outcome: Feedback submission rate target +50% (visible loop closure is the documented driver); founder credibility; SEO-friendly evergreen page.

items.summary: Codify tokens into /brand/system.css + /brand/tokens.json + a public design-system page.
items.problem: 99 pages share style.css but visual treatment of cards varies (oracle/, studio-pulse/, press/, games/ subtly different). Light/warm/cool/contrast themes have isolated debt. No token surface for AI agents or future projects to consume.
items.recipe: Extract canonical tokens (color ramps incl. all 5 themes, type scale, spacing, motion, surface elevation, sigil sizes) into `brand/tokens.json`. Generate `brand/system.css` from JSON at build. Publish `/brand/system/` page with live examples. Audit existing components against tokens — flag drift via new `check-design-token-drift.mjs`.
items.outcome: Visual cohesion across pages; new pages take <30min instead of <2h; sibling Studio projects can import tokens.json verbatim (CANON-006 brand-anchor).

items.summary: Establish placement matrix for vault-genome strip, rank-orb, page-sigil, hero-ticker, edge-swipe, forge-live tile, IGNIS tour pill.
items.problem: 7 ambient surfaces compete for the same top-right + top-edge real estate. S130 root-caused IGNIS-tour pill being misread as a 'dot'. Risk persists for any new ambient element.
items.recipe: Document canonical layout in `docs/AMBIENT_PLACEMENT_MATRIX.md`. Genome strip = top:0 fixed 3px sitewide. Rank-orb = single owner of nav-right anchor. Hero-ticker = only below-hero element. IGNIS tour = only opens on explicit gesture; never persistent. New `scripts/check-ambient-placement.mjs` gate.
items.outcome: Ambient surfaces read as one language; future regressions caught by structural gate, not founder bug reports.

items.summary: Replace drawer with iOS-native bottom-sheet nav.
items.problem: Drawer has been rebuilt 3× (S130, S132, S134 contract gates). Still a 'site-nav drawer'. Thumb reach on iPhone 11+ is bottom-third; current drawer is full-height left-overlay.
items.recipe: New `assets/nav-sheet.js` — bottom sheet with handle drag-to-close, 60vh peak, rank-orb + active page as top anchor, primary nav + Resources tray below. Edge-swipe-from-bottom triggers. Reuses sibling DOM (no portal-to-body needed). Backward-compatible: hamburger still opens it.
items.outcome: Mobile open-to-click target <2s (current ~4s); mobile bounce rate target −15%; modern app-like feel.

items.summary: ⌘K / Ctrl+K command palette replaces /search/.
items.problem: /search/ is a static page. Power-users + AI-fluent visitors expect ⌘K. No surface today exposes 'jump to anything' (project, rank, dispatch, page).
items.recipe: New `assets/command-palette.js` (lazy on first ⌘K). Index built at build-time: pages + 28 projects + ranks + recent dispatches + active members (public). Fuzzy search local. Recents in localStorage. Replaces /search/ with `<link rel=canonical>` to home. ⌘K keybinding global; mobile equivalent = nav-sheet search field.
items.outcome: Power-user retention; 'I can navigate this instantly' impression; reduces dependency on top-nav for deep destinations.

items.summary: Public site pulls Studio Hub /public-status endpoint into home spine; bidirectional health check.
items.problem: Studio Hub, Social Dashboard, IGNIS, Studio Ops are all internal — no public surface acknowledges them. Visitors don't see the studio's internal nervous system. CANON-018 (Ark) covers async cargo but no live handshake.
items.recipe: Studio Hub Worker exposes `/public-status` (counts only, no PII): repos online, active sessions, last ark broadcast at, IGNIS heartbeat. Website Worker fetches every 5min, caches in KV, surfaces as a 'Studio nervous system' tile on /oracle/. Same endpoint serves a /status/ public page (replacing the existing stub).
items.outcome: Public proof of internal sophistication; investor + AI-fluent visitor confidence; live signal cohesion.

items.summary: /ranks/ becomes a live opt-in fame wall; top 100 members + per-tier progression curve.
items.problem: /ranks/ exists but is descriptive (the 9-tier ladder). No social proof. /leaderboards/ exists but is game-scoped.
items.recipe: Supabase Realtime subscription to `vault_members` (where `public_profile = true`). Renders 100 anonymized-or-named cards by points + last-active. Per-tier completion bar at top. Opt-in toggle in /vault/member/settings/. Worker caches snapshot 30s.
items.outcome: Vanity drives joins (documented driver in community products); SPARKED-tier engagement target +30%; converts public traffic without an extractive form.

items.summary: When founder is active in studio-hub, a 1px gold underline appears under the wordmark sitewide.
items.problem: Founder Presence renders on home as an explicit tile. No subtle sitewide cue. Parasocial 'is the founder here right now' signal is leaked.
items.recipe: `assets/favicon-pulse.js` already pulls /api/founder-presence.json. Add: when `state.active === true`, set `body[data-founder-active]` → CSS `body[data-founder-active] .brand-wordmark { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gold); }`. BroadcastChannel sibling tabs (extends S156 mirror).
items.outcome: Subtle ambient brand signal on every page; visitors notice; reinforces 'the studio is a person.'

items.summary: Per-project AI-canonical pages at /<project>/.ai/ with structured prose AI agents cite verbatim.
items.problem: .well-known/llms.txt + per-project shards exist (S154). They're a directory, not cite-quality prose. When ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity describe VaultSpark, they paraphrase. We want them to paste.
items.recipe: Generator script reads PROJECT_REGISTRY + project README + project SOUL.md. Renders /<project>/.ai/index.html with: 1-line elevator, 3-bullet differentiators, founder quote, current state in 1 paragraph, 'cite this page' invitation. Robots-allowed. Linked from llms.txt.
items.outcome: Generative-AI search results cite VaultSpark text verbatim; SEO + brand consistency where humans don't read; ~2026 new ranking channel.

items.summary: Sitewide Organization + Person + CreativeWork JSON-LD with consistent @id graph.
items.problem: Pages have title/og tags but no entity graph. Google KG entry for VaultSpark Studios likely incomplete. AI agents have no schema anchor.
items.recipe: `scripts/build-jsonld.mjs` emits per-page JSON-LD into the critical shell. Organization (VaultSpark Studios LLC), Person (founder), 28 CreativeWork entries per project, MemberProgram for /vault/. `/.well-known/entity-graph.json` exposes the schema. All linked by `@id`.
items.outcome: Google KG / Bing entity graph entry; rich-result eligibility; AI agent schema clarity.

items.summary: Single Vault ID across vaultsparkstudios.com + joinvorn.com + usemindframe.com + callofdoodie.wtf via Vault SSO contract.
items.problem: Each studio property has separate auth. Returning Studio Member treated as stranger on Vorn. CANON Vault-SSO-Contract already declared (D-S119.3) but not wired across properties.
items.recipe: Phase 1: deploy Vault-SSO Worker at sso.vaultsparkstudios.com — JWT signing via Obelisk capability `obelisk.identity.verify`. Phase 2: each property's signup hits the SSO endpoint with property slug; existing member auto-merged. Phase 3: cross-property rank+points unified. Ship Phase 1 this audit; Phase 2/3 carry.
items.outcome: One Vault identity across 4+ properties; investor talking point; deep coherence.

items.summary: Passkey-first login; password fallback. Obelisk Phase 2 milestone.
items.problem: CANON-021 + Hub Phase 1 declared passkey-first deprecation of password. Vault login still password-primary + Turnstile-gated (4 different fix sessions). Passkey eliminates the entire Turnstile failure class.
items.recipe: WebAuthn registration during signup (passkey first, password optional fallback). Login flow: detect platform authenticator → passkey UI; fallback to password+Turnstile. Capability `obelisk.identity.verify` (already declared) supplies relying-party config. Migration: existing members prompted to enroll passkey on next login.
items.outcome: Login friction down (no captcha for passkey users); Turnstile failure surface shrinks 80%+; Obelisk Phase 2 milestone.

items.summary: Playwright pixel snapshots across iPhone 11/13/15, Pixel 7/8, iPad mini/Pro × 5 themes weekly.
items.problem: 5 founder-reported mobile regressions in last 30 sessions (drawer dark, hero cutoff, dot-on-scroll, brand wrap, etc.). Each was structurally preventable. Mobile contract gates catch CSS shape, not visual outcome.
items.recipe: Add `tests/visual-regression.spec.js` with playwright-snapshot. Baseline 6 routes × 6 devices × 2 themes = 72 snapshots. Threshold 0.1%. Weekly cron. Snapshot updates via PR review.
items.outcome: Mobile regressions caught pre-push (not by founder iPhone screenshots); fewer 'fix #4' sessions; CI confidence.

items.summary: /ignis/roi/ shows AI cost vs AI-suggested-shipped value loop.
items.problem: IGNIS audits + audit→implement loop runs every session. Public site doesn't show that AI is autonomously suggesting + shipping work. AI-native credibility leaked.
items.recipe: Aggregator joins `prompt_cache_metrics` ndjson + AUDIT*.json + commit refs. Renders: tokens spent · cache hit % · audit items shipped · cumulative founder time saved. New /ignis/roi/. Optional weekly tweet snippet generator.
items.outcome: Demonstrates AI-native studio; PR-friendly screenshot; investor talking point; gives perf-history a narrative twin.

items.summary: Cull /signal-log/, /vault-narrative/, /vault-wall/, /vault-treasury/, /membership-value/, /member/ singletons.
items.problem: 6+ pages exist as stubs or competing surfaces. Many were innovation experiments that never replaced their canonical sibling. Sitemap noise hurts crawler clarity.
items.recipe: Audit each: if content unique → merge target. If redundant → Worker 301. /signal-log/→/journal/. /vault-narrative/→/journal/?tag=narrative. /vault-wall/→/vault/member/wall. /vault-treasury/→/vault/investor/. /membership-value/→/vault/member/#value. /member/→/vault/member/.
items.outcome: −6 sitemap entries; one canonical path per intent; AI crawler model tightens.

items.summary: Build-time LQIP blur-up placeholders for hero/card images.
items.problem: AVIF wrappers shipped (S154). LCP image still pops in from nothing. Perceived perf has headroom.
items.recipe: Sharp-based generator writes 12-byte base64 placeholder per image; emitted into ``. Idempotent.
items.outcome: Perceived perf jump on slow connections; layout pre-paint feels intentional.

items.summary: S158 carry: post-deploy production perf trace + promote perf-budget to --strict.
items.problem: S158 left the prod-LCP-validate and perf-budget-strict carries open.
items.recipe: After S159 deploy: `measure-page-performance --check --base=https://vaultsparkstudios.com/` → append-perf-history → detect-regressions → if 2nd clean sample, flip check-perf-budget to --strict in build:check.
items.outcome: Production CWV claims provable; perf-budget guards every closeout going forward.
